extracted.name: Ultra Easy Pineapple Chicken Kabobs
extracted.description: These easy pineapple chicken kabobs start with skewered chicken and pineapple, brushed with barbecue sauce, then grilled for a quick and easy summertime meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
0.5 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces
0.25 cup barbeque sauce, or as needed
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Thread bell pepper, pineapple, chicken, and onion onto skewers; brush with barbecue sauce.
Cook on the preheated grill, turning frequently, until nicely browned on all sides and chicken is no longer pink in the center, 7 to 10 minutes per side.
